description: qualitygate's bare 'go build ./...' wrote the 4.2MB gofib binary into the repo root on every gate run; even though gitignored, it kept reappearing as worktree junk after each implementer cleanup. Gate must build outside the worktree.
resolution: qualitygate.nu now builds via 'go build -o (mktemp -d)/ ./...' and removes the temp dir; verified gate green with zero binary residue
